advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a regression test that escapes a `|` in a cfg-kind tombstone's name and replacement columns (monkeypatch `gen._cfg_tombstones` to return a `|`-bearing entry and assert the row splits into the expected cell count), mirroring the deprecation-table escaping test.
evidence: Diff adds escaping to the tombstone renderer: `repl = f"\`{_md_cell(replacement)}\`" if replacement else "_(no replacement)_"` and `lines.append(f"| \`{_md_cell(name)}\` | {repl} | {_md_cell(behavior)} |")` in scripts/gen_config_reference.py

New test `test_alias_table_escapes_pipes_in_name_and_replacement` monkeypatches `_deprecations.REGISTRY` with a Deprecation (cfg-kind), which feeds the DEPRECATION table, not the tombstone table (tombstones come from `gen._cfg_tombstones()` — see test at tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py:389 `monkeypatch.setattr(gen, '_cfg_tombstones', ...)`)

tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py:254-266 `test_config_reference_reflects_cfg_tombstones` asserts only `tomb.behavior in row` (third column) and locates the row with `_row_for(doc, tomb.name)` on the raw name — it would not detect a mis-split row from an unescaped `|` in a tombstone name or replacement
Named violating input: a cfg-kind tombstone with name `sample|removed` or replacement `the ["a"|"b"] form` renders a 4-column (mis-split) row that no test catches
advisory.finding: The tombstone alias-table renderer's newly-added pipe-escaping (`_md_cell(name)` and `_md_cell(replacement)` on the first two columns) has no regression test; the new escaping test covers only the deprecation renderer, and the existing tombstone test asserts only the third (behavior) column, so reverting the tombstone renderer's escaping leaves all tests green.
scenarios: A future cfg tombstone whose name or replacement contains a literal `|` renders a malformed GFM row (4 cells instead of 3) and ships undetected
A silent regression if the tombstone renderer's `_md_cell` call is removed in a later refactor
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a `test_tombstone_table_escapes_pipes_in_name_and_replacement` that monkeypatches `gen._cfg_tombstones` to yield an entry with `|` in both name and replacement, then asserts `len([c for c in re.split(r"(?<!\\)\|", row.strip()) if c.strip()]) == 3` as in the deprecation test.
